title: Set the price, see the gap

predict.q: Same market as before (Qd = 120 − 5P, Qs = 10P − 30). This time the price is stuck at **8**. What is there at a price of 8?

options.fb: 8 is below the equilibrium price of 10, so buyers want more (80) than sellers offer (50). That is a shortage; a surplus happens above equilibrium.
At 8, Qd = 80 and Qs = 50: buyers want 30 thousand more than sellers offer.
20 compares the 50 thousand supplied with the equilibrium quantity of 70. Compare Qd and Qs at the same price: 80 − 50 = 30.

task: Move the **price** slider from 8 up to 12 and watch the gap between the curves. The numbers appear when you check.

target.do: Move the price slider from 8 up to 12, then press Check.

takeaway: The shortage shrinks to zero at the equilibrium price, then a gap reopens on the other side as a surplus.
explore: Shortage 30 at 8, none at 10, surplus 30 at 12, shortage 60 at 6. Quantity traded peaks at 70 at a price of 10.
